def solve_tridiagonal(a, b, c, d):
    """Solve tridiagonal system Ax = d where:
    a = sub-diagonal, b = main diagonal, c = super-diagonal, d = RHS
    Uses Thomas algorithm
    """
    n = len(b)
    # Make copies
    ac, bc, cc, dc = [a[i] for i in range(n)], [b[i] for i in range(n)], \
                     [c[i] for i in range(n)], [d[i] for i in range(n)]
